_comment: Multi-step registration flows. Edited via /admin/registration/flows; rendered on landing pages by the 'registration-flow' section (pick a flow in the Page Builder). Field types: text, email, phone, number, textarea, select, choice (button group), yesno, file, computed (a live display-only price. When 'priced': true it is calculated SERVER-SIDE from the private pricing config (functions/api/_pricing-config.json, edited in the admin Pricing tab): names a 'selfField' and 'publisherField' number field, and offer = (payoutRatePct/100) × (selfRecovery × self + publisherRecovery × publisher). Supports prefix/suffix and gateOn to hide until a field is filled), works-summary (display-only list of works read from an uploaded claim form). A file field may carry 'extract' (a server extractor name, e.g. 'bartz-claim') plus 'extractMap' ({ flowFieldId: 'path.into.result' }) — on upload the file is POSTed to /api/extract-claim and the named fields auto-fill. Each STEP has a required 'heading' (the big question people see) plus four optional extras: 'title' (small text shown above the heading), 'explainer' (small text shown below it), 'disclaimer' (small print shown just above THAT step's Back/Next/Submit row — e.g. a consent statement right before a final step; different from the registration-flow section's own 'disclosure' prop, which shows below the whole card on every step), and 'optional': true (renders a "Skip this step" link — its fields' required flags are then only enforced if the visitor engages with the step instead of skipping). A step with showIf only appears when the named earlier field equals the given value; a FIELD may also carry showIf (same {fieldId, equals} shape) to conditionally show/hide within the same step — used to keep a branch driver (like Authored/Published) and its branch-specific fields together on one page. A 'choice'/'yesno' field renders as stacked radio buttons with none pre-selected — the visitor must actively pick one. A field may set 'hideLabel': true to keep its label for screen readers while hiding it visually — for when the step heading already asks the question the label would just repeat. A required file field may set 'skipLabel' (e.g. "I don't have my claim form") to render an alternate button next to "Next" that satisfies the requirement in place of an attached file — use when not everyone filling out the form will have the file. A field may set 'row': '<any id>' — consecutive fields sharing the same row id render side by side instead of stacked (e.g. First name + Last name), to save vertical space. IMPORTANT — the email and phone fields can be renamed freely (functions/api/register.js finds them by field TYPE, not id), but the first/last name fields must keep one of the recognized ids — 'first_name'/'last_name', 'first'/'last', or legacy 'firstName'/'lastName' — the server has no type-based way to distinguish a name field from any other text field, so renaming those ids to anything else breaks the confirmation email, Google Sheet row, and Attio push silently. Submissions POST to /api/register → notification email (+ Google Sheet, + Attio when ATTIO_API_KEY is configured, labeled with attioLabel).
